descriptions.notStarted: I lost the seed that Swallow gave. I better go visit again.
descriptions.inProgress: I lost the seed that Swallow gave, so I had to explain the circumstances to it. After some deliberation, it decided to look for another seed, and asked me to wait for a bit, then talk to it again.
descriptions.completed: I went to see Swallow because I have lost the seed myself, and it gave me a new one. Now, who should I give this to?
